description: Completely replace the Activity.tsx page with a new design featuring: page header with icon/title/subtitle and date picker + export button; 6 stat cards row; tab navigation (6 tabs); filter bar with search and 4 dropdowns; activity table with 8 rows and pagination; right sidebar with Live Activity Feed, Activity by Type donut chart, Top Active Agents leaderboard, and Quick Filters grid. All with static mock data, dark theme, using Card component, lucide-react icons, and recharts PieChart.
steps: Replace the entire content of /projects/sandbox/NVLabsCompany/dashboard/src/pages/Activity.tsx with a new implementation

Import Card from @/components/common/Card, icons from lucide-react (Activity, BarChart3, CheckCircle2, XCircle, Clock, Users, Zap, Search, Filter, ChevronDown, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, MoreHorizontal, ExternalLink, Calendar), and PieChart/Pie/Cell/Tooltip/ResponsiveContainer from recharts

Define static mock data: statCards array (6 items with label, value, change, changeUp, icon, iconBg, iconColor), pageTabs array, filterDropdowns, activityRows array (8 entries with event name, type badge, description, metadata, agent/user, time, status), liveFeedItems (5 items), activityByTypeData for donut chart (6 categories with name, value, percentage, color), topAgents (5 items with name, count, color), quickFilters (6 items)
Build the main component with flex gap-4 layout: flex-1 main content area and w-80 right sidebar

Main content: page header (Activity icon + title + subtitle, right side date picker and Export button), stat cards in grid-cols-6, tab navigation with All Activity active, filter bar, activity table in Card padding=none with table headers EVENT/DETAILS/AGENT-USER/TIME/STATUS and 8 rows, pagination footer

Right sidebar: Live Activity Feed section with green Live indicator and 5 feed items with timestamps; Activity by Type donut chart using recharts PieChart with center total label (2,842 Total) and legend; Top Active Agents numbered leaderboard with colored progress bars; Quick Filters 2x3 grid of filter buttons with colored dots
Ensure all text uses white for primary, gray-400 for secondary. All badges use colored bg with matching text. Table rows have hover:bg-white/[0.02] and border-b border-white/[0.05]
Run npm run build to verify zero TypeScript errors
acceptance_criteria: npm run build (tsc -b && vite build) completes with zero errors
Activity.tsx exports a function Activity component
No API calls, useEffect, useState for fetching, or randomness - all data is static
Uses recharts PieChart for the Activity by Type donut chart
Layout uses flex gap-4 with flex-1 main and w-80 sidebar
Contains all 8 activity rows with exact data specified
Contains all 6 stat cards with exact values specified
Contains Live Activity Feed, Activity by Type chart, Top Active Agents, and Quick Filters in sidebar
